# ORCA - Cardiff University Institutional Research Repository

> ORCA is Cardiff University's open access institutional repository for managing, discovering, and sharing research outputs including publications, theses, and scholarly works.

ORCA (Open Research Cardiff Archive) serves as Cardiff University's central platform for depositing and accessing research materials. The repository supports open access initiatives, thesis management, and metadata harvesting through OAI-PMH standards, making Cardiff's research discoverable through major academic search engines and aggregators.

## Getting Started

- [ORCA Homepage](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk): ORCA homepage - Cardiff University's institutional research repository
- [About the Repository](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/information.html): About ORCA - institutional repository overview and metadata harvesting
- [FAQs for ORCA](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about ORCA repository and open access

## Depositing Research

- [Adding Research to ORCA](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/help): Guide for depositing and adding research to ORCA repository
- [Your Research Thesis](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/deposit-thesis.html): Instructions for thesis deposit with embargo and licensing guidance
- [Repository Policies](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/policies.html): ORCA repository policies, submission guidelines, and copyright rules

## Discovering Research

- [Browse Items](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/view): Browse and discover research items in ORCA repository
- [Latest Additions to ORCA](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/cgi/latest): Latest research additions and recent publications in ORCA
